description: Field Validation of Hydraulic Model-Based Leak Localization Methods in Water Distribution Networks is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Yuanyang Liu, Filippo Pecci (Princeton University). This is the dataset for the leak trials conducted in an operational water network and belongs to the article "Field Validation of Hydraulic Model-Based Leak Localization Methods in Water Distribution Networks". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
